Patrick is [[Kassey (DS)|Kassey's]] twin brother. The brothers are both pyrotechnics, and they make the fireworks for the annual fireworks display. Kassey is the best pyrotechnician in the world, and Patrick is second best. The brothers make the fireworks for the annual Fireworks Festival. In order to tell the brothers apart, look at their clothing.
